result_text:
Fixed. The bug was in `src/roman.ts:9` — the function computed `next` but never used it, so every value was just added.

The fix applies the subtractive rule: when a digit is smaller than the one following it, subtract it instead:

```ts
total += v < next ? -v : v;
```

All 6 tests in `tests/roman.test.ts` now pass with `bun test` (6 pass, 0 fail).
